description: Search 300K+ EV charging stations worldwide by location, country, operator, connector type, and power level. Returns station address, GPS coordinates, connectors (Type 2, CCS, CHAdeMO), power kW, operator, status. Filter by min power for fast charging. Largest open EV charging database (Open Charge Map)

country_code.description: ISO 2-letter country code to filter by (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE")

distance_unit.description: Distance unit: KM or Miles (default KM)

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50 for fast charging)

operator_id.description: Filter by charging network operator ID

name: ev.charging.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search EV Charging Stations
